title: Grateful Dead Live at Hill Auditorium on 1971-12-14
source: 7" BBD reel>PCM501ES(beta)>PCM501ES analog out>Fostex D5 @ optical out 48KHz>HD. DAT-1 > Soundforge 4.5 > WAV/SHN mastering by Tim Deibert

ai_review.summary: Nice‑quality soundboard capture with Pigpen’s standout “Run Rudolph Run” and strong Truckin’/Casey Jones moments, though the overall show is considered average.
ai_review.review: The recording, a soundboard source, delivers clear audio for its era with Pigpen unusually high in the mix, making his “Run Rudolph Run” a highlight. Reviewers note great performances of Truckin’ and Casey Jones, but describe the concert as generally average aside from those peaks.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and praised both the audio fidelity and specific song moments; the show is deemed solid but not exceptional, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear for the time period with Pigpen’s vocals prominent; slight mix‑up noted on Casey Jones but no major issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall average flow with a few high‑energy peaks; reviewers feel the continuity of the Cryptical > Drums > The Other One sequence is broken by track changes.
